title: Four tower differences
notes: First routes: K-1 P1, then either P3-4 for one-/two-move starts or P2 for a longevity search; grades 2-3 and 4-5 P1-2. On return, K-1 can compare three stations or change the order (P5-6). Grades 2-3 can investigate predecessors (P3), station count (P4), or order and maximum bounds (P5-6). Grades 4-5 can make parity shadows (P5), then connect scaling and boundedness to termination (P6-8). Retain all upper proofs for deeper visits. Always compute four outputs from one untouched old state before swapping mats.
